sections.content: mellett (next to), előtt (in front of) and mögött (behind) are postpositions — words that show location but come AFTER the noun they describe, unlike English prepositions, which come before.

items.spanish: A konyha a nappali mellett van.
items.english: The kitchen is next to the living room.

items.spanish: Az asztal a kanapé előtt van.
items.english: The table is in front of the sofa.

items.spanish: Az ágy az ablak mögött van.
items.english: The bed is behind the window.

sections.content: Read Hungarian postpositional phrases back-to-front to get the English word order: ablak mögött = 'window behind' = 'behind the window'.
